description: Inventory of every production Foundry Script type representation, its live kind enums, and its semantic child slots. Kind ids and numeric values are validated against the live C++ enums by test_type_completeness_census.h, so a renumbered or appended enum value fails the census rather than silently diverging.

representations.summary: The analyzer's resolved type record. Carries the full declared shape: widths, bounds, callable signatures, enum payloads, provenance flags, and every recursive child in one structure.

kind_enums.sentinel_note: The MAX sentinel (value 9) is a bound, not a descriptor, and is excluded.

child_slots.summary: Typed Array/Dictionary element types and, for TUPLE, the element types in declaration order.
Alternatives of a static type set, already normalized: aliases expanded, nested unions flattened, nullability hoisted, duplicates removed, order canonicalized.
Type arguments of a specialized type handle, e.g. the int in Box[int].
Optional upper bound of a generic type parameter; zero or one element.
Rich parameter types of a Callable/Signal signature, preserved beside MethodInfo which cannot store them.
Return type of a Callable signature; empty for signals.
The variadic rest tail of a Foundry Script signature; empty, or exactly one resolved Array element type.
Payload field types of one tagged-union case, in declaration order.
Payload field names of a tagged-union case; an analyzer-only convenience over the positional runtime carrier.

representations.summary: The compiled runtime type descriptor used by every runtime boundary: is tests, typed stores, member slots, and operands. Erases analyzer-only shape (enum/tagged-union identity, callable signatures, bounds) while keeping widths, container elements, type arguments, and union alternatives.

kind_enums.wire_note: UNION must remain the highest value; the compiled-bytecode loader rejects a deserialized kind above it (modules/foundry_script/fs_function.h:82).

kind_enums.sentinel_note: The MAX sentinel (value 9) is a bound, not a descriptor, and is excluded.

child_slots.summary: Typed container element types and tuple element types; the tuple value itself erases to a read-only Array and only is tests keep the shape.
Reified type arguments of a specialized script or trait slot; part of the runtime type identity, not metadata.
Alternatives in the analyzer's canonical order; a union has no carrier of its own, so the membership test is their disjunction.

representations.summary: The engine-level ContainerType record and its validating twin ContainerTypeValidate (core/variant/container_type_validate.h:59) — the shared currency of typed containers, reflection metadata, class-handle specialization, and compiled constants.

child_slots.summary: Recursive element types of a typed Array or Dictionary, each carrying its own numeric width descriptor.
Reified type arguments of a specialized script element type or handle, distinct from element_types which describes container contents.

representations.summary: The serialized FSDataType record inside a compiled .fsb, written by FSBytecodeExporter::encode_data_type and rebuilt by FSBytecodeLoader::decode_data_type (modules/foundry_script/fs_bytecode_loader.h:158). Script identity travels as (path, fully qualified class name), never as a pointer.

kind_enums.wire_note: Serialized as one byte per record; the loader rejects a kind above UNION, so the serialized kind set is exactly the runtime kind set.

child_slots.summary: Length-prefixed recursive element records; a width nested at any depth is written the same way as one at the root.
Length-prefixed recursive type-argument records of a specialized handle.
Length-prefixed recursive alternative records; the union membership obligation survives reload intact.

representations.summary: How a class-type-parameter member resolves its reified argument at runtime: FIXED bindings carry a concrete FSDataType that deliberately keeps TYPE_PARAMETER nodes at any depth, OPEN bindings carry a leaf ordinal. MemberInfo (modules/foundry_script/foundry_script.h:194) also carries tuple_slot_shape beside the erased data_type.

child_slots.summary: The concrete argument of a FIXED binding as an FSDataType that keeps unresolved TYPE_PARAMETER nodes so each further extends step substitutes them recursively.
The declared shape of a tuple-typed member whose data_type erases to a bare untyped Array; the only input a reflective write has for tuple slots.

representations.summary: The PropertyInfo projection: the engine-facing description of a member (FSParser::DataType::to_property_info) and its inverse (FSAnalyzer::type_from_property, modules/foundry_script/fs_analyzer.h:1010). PropertyInfo is also serialized into .fsb member records (modules/foundry_script/fs_bytecode_export.cpp:404).

The Foundry Script source spelling reconstructed from a stored descriptor alone: FSDataType::get_source_type_name, plus the analyzer-side renderers FSParser::DataType::to_string (modules/foundry_script/fs_parser.h:333) and to_string_diagnostic (modules/foundry_script/fs_parser.h:338). Recurses through containers, generic arguments, tuples, and nullability, so Array[int] and Array[long] stay distinguishable.

What a runtime value knows about its own specialization: the leaf script plus the type arguments reified against that leaf, from an instance (modules/foundry_script/fs_function.h:71) or a class handle (modules/foundry_script/fs_function.h:75). Consumed by FSDataType::specialization_matches (modules/foundry_script/fs_function.h:185) under narrowing and gradual rules.

child_slots.summary: The reified argument vector expressed against the value's own leaf parameters; an empty vector is absence of evidence, not a claim.
